searches.reason: Establish whether the BERT4Rec diagnostics measure valid prediction behavior before interpreting ranking failures. Seek practical probes for target leakage, left-padding invariance, appended-mask inference, and controlled history perturbations that connect failures to masking, positional representations, and attention. Require final-nonpadding readout and distinguish sensitivity measurements from causal explanations.
searches.query: BERT4Rec diagnostic probes masked target leakage appended mask inference left padding invariance history perturbation recency order sensitivity 2024 2025 2026

searches.reason: Develop a feedback-grounded specificity audit using available titles, descriptions, histories, and timestamps. Seek contrastive probes that compare broad similarity with explicit compatibility or purpose evidence, plus recent versus older interests. Treat unidentified items as unassessable and inferred ownership, mood, or immediate need as uncertain; validate interpretations against the twenty users’ feedback rather than inventing attributes.
searches.query: sequential recommendation diagnosis contrastive item pairs compatibility redundancy intent specificity recency user feedback unknown item identity abstention title description 2024 2025 2026

searches.reason: Make diagnostic conclusions trustworthy under the fixed benchmark and limited feedback. Seek paired stress tests, user-level uncertainty estimates, and controlled single-model ablations linking diagnostic changes to macro validation HR@10. Investigate when sampled-negative margins fail to reflect ranking among 99 unique negatives or full-catalog recommendations; preserve the evaluator and use training-only pseudo-holdouts for additional probes.
searches.query: recommender diagnostic metric validation sampled negatives full catalog ranking disagreement user bootstrap uncertainty controlled ablation HR@10 2024 2025 2026
